page.notes: Catchword "miliæ" is the second half of "familiæ", split at the line end. Greek word in the main text "διδασκαλικὰ" is doubtful. The third marginal note's Greek word is unreadable and marked illegible. The "defint" in the first paragraph is doubtful, probably for "desint". Printed long s and f in the text (e.g. "fi", "hifce", "excufandi") are transcribed as plain s. The marginal note labels were set in small italic type.
